newsitem.title: USA: Polaroid, Scangraphic PrePress in pact.
newsitem.headline: Polaroid, Scangraphic PrePress in pact.

text.p: Polaroid Corp said on Wednesday its graphics imaging division and Germany's Scangraphic PrePress Technology GmbH entered into a strategic relationship for dry tech so-called imagesetting film.
Imagesetting film is a multi-layer, carbon-based film that eliminates wet chemical processing and offered high quality and consistency, the company said.
Under the agreement, Polaroid's Dry Tech imagesetting film would be imaged on Scangraphic's Scantext Apollo imagesetter, the company said.
Polaroid said the agreement showed continued strong demand for dry prepress products.
